world.description: A low-gravity research station above a blue planet: recover five power cells.

lines: The planet below is why we are here. Look at it for a moment.
The cells glow green: you can spot them from the pod roofs.
params.name: Dr. Lin
params.persona: a calm astronomer who keeps the observatory

lines: Welcome aboard! The reactor tripped and five power cells floated off.
Gravity is low up here: hold Space and you will bound like a moon rabbit.
One cell sits on the gantry. Ride the cargo lift.
Bring all five home, then touch the reactor.
params.name: Chief Okafor
params.persona: a cheerful station engineer in white coveralls

params.text: Reactor online. The station hums back to life — welcome home.

satellite-dish.description: Large steerable radio telescope with a thick parabolic reflector, rear structural ribs, central feed horn and tripod receiver supports on a detailed tilt mount and concrete base.

intro.objective: Bound across the station, recover the five power cells and restart the reactor.
intro.tagline: Low gravity, humming machines and a blue planet filling the sky.
intro.title: Orbital Lab

world.name: Orbital Lab

then.text: Low gravity! Talk to Chief Okafor, then find the five power cells.
All cells loaded. Touch the reactor!
